about: An idea the user turned down, next to one real task for later.

turns: The handler runs one query per recipe to load its tags (an N+1 pattern). I changed it to a single join, and it now takes about 80 ms locally. Another option on top would be a Redis cache in front of the endpoint.
No Redis, I don't want another service to run. The join is enough.
Agreed, no cache. The join fix is committed.
